description: SearchableItem schema for Confluence Cloud pages
title: Confluence Cloud Page Schema

ConfluenceCloudPage.description: SearchableItem for a Confluence Cloud page

isContainer.description: Whether this item is a container for other items in the index. Always false for Confluence pages, which are leaf content items.

containerId.description: Identifier of the parent container item, if any. Always null for Confluence pages.

properties.description: The Confluence page's own fields, covering identity, space context, authorship, lifecycle state, labels, and (via the wrapper) body, comments, and attachments.

Id.description: The unique numeric identifier assigned to the Confluence page (Confluence Cloud content id). A long-form numeric string used in Atlassian REST lookups and audit trails; immutable across edits. Equals the wrapper-level 'id' and 'displayName'.

SpaceName.description: The name of the Confluence space that contains this page, shown in the UI and navigation. In this corpus space names follow an '<Org>-<Function>' convention (e.g., 'EcoSync-Engineering') and correspond to the space identified by SpaceKey and SpaceId.

SpaceDescription.description: A one-to-three sentence summary of the space's purpose and the material it contains, shown on the space landing page and used for semantic retrieval and classification. Maximum 500 characters.
examples: Engineering team documentation covering software development, architecture decisions, technical specifications, code reviews, and development processes for the EcoSync platform.
Marketing documentation including campaign strategies, brand guidelines, content calendars, market research, and growth initiatives for EcoSync Solutions.

SpaceURL.description: The Atlassian Cloud REST API URL for the space, of the form 'https://<site>.atlassian.net/wiki/rest/api/space/<SpaceKey>'. The trailing path segment equals SpaceKey.

SpaceLabels.description: High-level labels applied to the space, providing cross-space semantic grouping in enterprise search. Lowercase, hyphenated tokens with no whitespace; typically includes a label derived from the space name (e.g., 'ecosync-engineering'). May be empty.

PageTree.description: A human-readable breadcrumb of the page's location within the space hierarchy, using ' > ' separators from the space root down to the page (e.g., 'EcoSync-Engineering > PRDs > <Title>'). Mirrors Confluence's left-hand navigation tree; the final segment equals Title, and it parallels ItemPath (which uses slash separators).
examples: EcoSync-Engineering > PRDs > EcoSync Suite Enhancement PRD
EcoSync-DataScience > Data Science & ML Lab > Week 1 Onboarding Notes

ItemPath.description: A canonical slash-delimited path of the page's location within the space (e.g., '/EcoSync-Engineering/PRDs/<Title>'), a machine-friendly hierarchy key. Parallels PageTree, which encodes the same hierarchy with ' > ' separators; the final segment corresponds to Title.

Title.description: The title of the Confluence page. Concisely summarizes the content and appears in search results, navigation, page listings, link previews, and (URL-encoded) as the trailing slug of Url. A well-formed title improves discoverability and relevance scoring. Maximum 255 characters.
examples: EcoSync Suite Enhancement PRD: Sustainable Usage Insights MVP

Url.description: The fully qualified Confluence Cloud page URL, of the form 'https://<site>.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/<space-slug>/pages/<page-number>/<title-slug>'. Used for navigation, previews, and external linking. It contains a space slug, a page-content number, and a slug derived from the Title (approximate URL-encoding; punctuation may be normalized or dropped).

Type.description: The Confluence content object type. 'page' is structured, persistent documentation and reference content; 'blogpost' is a time-bound announcement or update. Supports filtering and content-based routing.

Status.description: The lifecycle state of the page. 'draft' is unpublished work-in-progress; 'current' is active, maintained content; 'archived' is deprecated/legacy material kept for reference; 'trashed' is content pending deletion or removed from standard navigation. Drives lifecycle analysis, cleanup automation, and ranking.

Labels.description: Labels applied directly to this page for classification, topic discovery, semantic search, and filtering. Lowercase, hyphenated tokens with no whitespace, expressing themes or domains (e.g., 'incident-management', 'esg-metrics'). May be empty.

Likes.description: Count of user likes/reactions on the page, reflecting engagement and visibility. Non-negative integer; higher counts often correlate with widely referenced or operationally important documentation. New or niche pages are typically 0.

IconUrl.description: URL of the page or space icon thumbnail shown throughout the Confluence UI, typically of the form 'https://<site>.atlassian.net/wiki/download/thumbnails/<id>/space-icon.png'. Small PNG/SVG asset used to visually distinguish spaces and content.

Authors.description: Authors who created or significantly contributed to the page. Each entry is a user identity. The first author corresponds to CreatedByName.

items.description: Identity of an author who created or significantly contributed to the page.

ExternalId.description: Unique identifier of the user in Confluence, a stable account id (GUID-style in this corpus, with hyphens).

Email.description: Corporate email address of the user. Shares the same domain as every other identity on the page.

ExternalName.description: Full display name of the user as shown in Confluence.

PrincipalType.description: Always 'user' for individual people, never groups.

id.description: Identity resolution key. Equals the user's Email exactly.

CreatedByName.description: Identity of the user who originally created the page. Its Email equals CreatedByEmail.

ExternalId.description: Unique identifier of the user in Confluence, a stable account id (GUID-style in this corpus, with hyphens).

Email.description: Corporate email address of the user. Shares the same domain as every other identity on the page.

ExternalName.description: Full display name of the user as shown in Confluence.

PrincipalType.description: Always 'user' for individual people, never groups.

id.description: Identity resolution key. Equals the user's Email exactly.

CreatedByEmail.description: Corporate email address of the user who created the page. A convenience scalar that mirrors CreatedByName.Email exactly, enabling simplified filtering and identity resolution without descending into the identity object.

CreatedOn.description: The page's initial creation timestamp in ISO 8601 (UTC) format. Used for chronological ordering, version-history analysis, temporal ranking, and lifecycle governance. Must be less than or equal to UpdatedOn.

UpdatedByName.description: Identity of the user who most recently updated the page. Its Email equals UpdatedByEmail.

ExternalId.description: Unique identifier of the user in Confluence, a stable account id (GUID-style in this corpus, with hyphens).

Email.description: Corporate email address of the user. Shares the same domain as every other identity on the page.

ExternalName.description: Full display name of the user as shown in Confluence.

PrincipalType.description: Always 'user' for individual people, never groups.

id.description: Identity resolution key. Equals the user's Email exactly.

UpdatedByEmail.description: Corporate email address of the user who most recently updated the page. A convenience scalar that mirrors UpdatedByName.Email exactly, enabling identity resolution across analytics and governance workflows.

UpdatedOn.description: The page's most recent modification timestamp in ISO 8601 (UTC) format. Used to evaluate freshness, drive change notifications, and inform recency-based ranking. Must be greater than or equal to CreatedOn.

SpaceId.description: The unique numeric identifier of the Confluence space, used in Atlassian APIs, auditing, and indexing to reference the space across environments. Long-form numeric string; consistent for all pages within the same space.

SpaceKey.description: The immutable key of the Confluence space, used in URLs, permission models, and routing; unique within the site. Appears as the trailing segment of SpaceURL. Typically a short uppercase token.

SpaceStatus.description: Lifecycle state of the Confluence space. 'current' is an active space in normal use; 'archived' is a deprecated or historical space retained for reference and compliance.

SpaceType.description: Type of Confluence space. 'global' spaces are organization-wide content areas for teams or departments; 'personal' spaces are user-owned areas for drafts or private notes.

accessControlList.description: Access-control entries for the page. Exactly one entry granting read access to EVERYONE (all authenticated users in the tenant).

principal.description: The access principal for this rule. For EVERYONE grants, applies to all authenticated users in the tenant.

type.description: Scope of this principal. Always 'everyone' — applies to all authenticated users in the tenant.

value.description: The canonical string value for the everyone principal. Must be the uppercase literal 'EVERYONE'.

identitySource.description: Not applicable for the 'everyone' principal. Always null.

identitySourceEnum.description: Identity provider for this tenant. Always 'azureActiveDirectory'.

identityType.description: Numeric code for the principal category. 3 represents the 'everyone' group type. Always 3 for EVERYONE grants.

identitySourceProperties.description: Not applicable for the 'everyone' principal. Always null.

metadata.description: Additional principal metadata. Always null for the 'everyone' principal.

displayName.description: Display name override. Always null for the 'everyone' principal.

ruleNode.description: Not applicable for simple EVERYONE grant rules. Always null.

accessType.description: Whether this entry grants or denies access. Always 'grant'.

transformedIdentity.description: Not applicable for the 'everyone' principal. Always null.

UniversalAccessControlBlock.description: Universal access-control block. Not used for Confluence pages; access is expressed via accessControlList. Always null.

activityList.description: Optional list of page activity events (e.g., created, modified, viewed, commented). Always null for Confluence Cloud pages; page activity is not carried on this envelope.

payload.description: Base64-encoded binary content for OCR. Not applicable to Confluence pages (contentEnrichmentData is null).

mimeType.description: MIME type of the payload binary content.

contentEnrichmentData.description: Enrichment payload for OCR processing. Null for Confluence Cloud pages.

content.description: The rendered body of the page. 'parsedData' holds the HTML body; 'type' is always 'html'; 'annotation' and 'semanticContent' are always null.

parsedData.description: The HTML body of the page. Empty string if the page has no body.
examples:
Overview

This page documents the EcoSync data ingestion service, covering source connectors, transformation stages, and monitoring.

Runbook

  1. Check the pipeline dashboard.
  2. Re-run the failed stage.

  • Set up your development environment.
  • Read the platform architecture overview.
  • Join the team standup.

type.description: Format of 'parsedData'. Always 'html' for Confluence Cloud pages - 'parsedData' contains the rendered HTML body. All other enum values are reserved and must not be used.

annotation.description: Reserved; always null for Confluence Cloud pages.

semanticContent.description: Reserved; always null for Confluence Cloud pages.

associatedItemsMetadata.description: Metadata describing associated child items. Null for Confluence pages; associated content is carried by the comments and attachments arrays.

uploadedBy.description: Identity of the user who uploaded this attachment.

ExternalId.description: Unique identifier of the user in Confluence, a stable account id (GUID-style in this corpus, with hyphens).

Email.description: Corporate email address of the user. Shares the same domain as every other identity on the page.

ExternalName.description: Full display name of the user as shown in Confluence.

PrincipalType.description: Always 'user' for individual people, never groups.

id.description: Identity resolution key. Equals the user's Email exactly.

uploadedTimestamp.description: When the file was attached, ISO 8601 (UTC). Between the page CreatedOn and UpdatedOn.

attachmentName.description: Filename of the attached file including extension. Confluence attachment types include images (png, jpg), documents (pdf, docx), spreadsheets (xlsx), presentations (pptx), text (txt), and markdown (md).

entitySemanticType.description: Semantic type of the entity. Always 'document' for attachments.

entityContent.description: The attachment content, represented per the (entityEncoding, entityFormat) pairing. For new data: raw searchable text for text/HTML/markdown and for image OCR or descriptions; base64 of the original file bytes for PDF and Office documents (entityFormat='unknown'). May be an empty string for some binary documents (observed for a minority of pdf/docx/pptx files) whose bytes were not inlined; the attachment metadata is still present.

entityEncoding.description: Encoding of entityContent. Use 'raw' for text you want searchable (text/log/CSV, HTML, markdown, and image OCR or descriptions). Use 'b64' for real file binaries (PDF, DOCX/XLSX/PPTX).

entityFormat.description: Content representation of the attachment. New data must use one of {txt, html, markdown, unknown} following the recommended pairings: text/log/CSV -> raw+txt; HTML -> raw+html; Markdown -> raw+markdown; PDF and DOCX/XLSX/PPTX -> b64+unknown; images (PNG/JPG) and SVG -> raw+txt (OCR text or a human-readable description). The file-type values (png, jpg, jpeg, svg, pdf, docx, pptx, xlsx) are legacy and retained only so existing data validates; do not emit them for new data.

commentId.description: Unique numeric string identifier of the comment, unique across all comments in the dataset.

parentCommentId.description: The commentId of the parent comment if this is a reply, or null for a top-level comment.

creator.description: Identity of the user who wrote this comment.

ExternalId.description: Unique identifier of the user in Confluence, a stable account id (GUID-style in this corpus, with hyphens).

Email.description: Corporate email address of the user. Shares the same domain as every other identity on the page.

ExternalName.description: Full display name of the user as shown in Confluence.

PrincipalType.description: Always 'user' for individual people, never groups.

id.description: Identity resolution key. Equals the user's Email exactly.

modifier.description: Identity of the user who last edited this comment; equals creator if never edited.

ExternalId.description: Unique identifier of the user in Confluence, a stable account id (GUID-style in this corpus, with hyphens).

Email.description: Corporate email address of the user. Shares the same domain as every other identity on the page.

ExternalName.description: Full display name of the user as shown in Confluence.

PrincipalType.description: Always 'user' for individual people, never groups.

id.description: Identity resolution key. Equals the user's Email exactly.

createdDateTime.description: When the comment was created, ISO 8601 (UTC). Between the page CreatedOn and UpdatedOn.

modifiedDateTime.description: When the comment was last edited, ISO 8601 (UTC). >= createdDateTime and <= page UpdatedOn; equals createdDateTime if never edited.

mentionedUsers.description: List of users mentioned or tagged in this comment using @mentions. Empty array if no users are mentioned.

items.description: Identity of a user @mentioned in this comment.

ExternalId.description: Unique identifier of the user in Confluence, a stable account id (GUID-style in this corpus, with hyphens).

Email.description: Corporate email address of the user. Shares the same domain as every other identity on the page.

ExternalName.description: Full display name of the user as shown in Confluence.

PrincipalType.description: Always 'user' for individual people, never groups.

id.description: Identity resolution key. Equals the user's Email exactly.

reactions.description: List of emoji reactions or likes on this comment from other employees. Empty array if no reactions exist.

reactionType.description: The emoji reaction type added to the comment. 'Like' is the most common reaction; 'Love', 'Celebrate', 'Insightful', and 'Curious' appear on pages with strong employee engagement.

reactionBy.description: Identity of the user who added this reaction.

ExternalId.description: Unique identifier of the user in Confluence, a stable account id (GUID-style in this corpus, with hyphens).

Email.description: Corporate email address of the user. Shares the same domain as every other identity on the page.

ExternalName.description: Full display name of the user as shown in Confluence.

PrincipalType.description: Always 'user' for individual people, never groups.

id.description: Identity resolution key. Equals the user's Email exactly.

reactionTimestamp.description: When the reaction was added, ISO 8601 (UTC). >= comment createdDateTime and <= page UpdatedOn.

entityContent.description: The comment body. New data should carry it raw per entityFormat - for example a raw HTML string with entityEncoding='raw', entityFormat='html'. Existing data stores base64-encoded HTML (entityEncoding='b64', entityFormat='html').

entityEncoding.description: Encoding of the comment body in entityContent. Use 'raw' to submit the body as-is (recommended for new data). 'b64' is base64-encoded and is used by existing data.

entityFormat.description: Format of the comment body. 'html' for rich-text comments (the norm for Confluence), 'txt' for plain text, 'markdown' for markdown. New data should pair the format with entityEncoding='raw' (raw+html, raw+txt, or raw+markdown).

itemVersion.description: Integer version stamp used by the indexing layer. Null for Confluence pages.

contentDomainCategoryName.description: Content domain category. Always 'wikis' for Confluence Cloud pages.

isAssociatedItem.description: Whether this item is an associated child of another item. Always false - Confluence pages are top-level items.

dataSourceResponse.description: Raw data-source response payload retained by the connector. Null for Confluence pages.

displayName.description: Display name of the item. For Confluence pages this holds the numeric page id (equals properties.Id).

shouldHashId.description: Whether the item id should be hashed before storage. Always false for Confluence pages.

hashedId.description: The hashed item id when id hashing is applied. Null for Confluence pages.

id.description: The item's primary identifier. For Confluence pages this is the numeric page id (equals properties.Id and displayName).
